units: <cite ref="Yevamot 120a:10">Yeb. 120ᵃ</cite> … <he>פ׳ ולא פרצוף ולא פ׳ וכ׳</he> an identification by the forehead without the face, or by the face without the forehead is illegal; <cite ref="Bekhorot 46b:12">Bekh. 46ᵇ</cite>.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 46b:12">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 3:5">Nidd. III, 5</cite> <he>איזהו רוב ראשו משתצא פַּדַּחְתּוֹ</he> (not <he>משיצא</he>) what is ‘the larger part of its (the infant’s) head’? when its forehead comes forth.
